audit: Old /gb/en-gb/size-guide/ 404s; guide is /customer-service/size-fit-guide/. Tops table prints no unit; the bra table on the same page is labelled cm and overlaps it. Old single values replaced by ranges: S 86/67/91 -> 82-89/65-72/89-96; L 95/76/100 -> 96-104/79-87/103-111; XL 101/82/106 -> 104-114/87-96/111-119. 2XL added. UK/US/EU removed (not published on the clothing chart).
